name: University of Notre Dame need-based aid (international)
amount: Meets 100% of demonstrated need (no loans in aid offers)
dlText: Regular Decision 1 Jan 2027 (time not stated); CSS Profile by 15 Jan 2027
note: Notre Dame is need-blind for international first-year applicants and meets full demonstrated need for all undergraduates regardless of citizenship. File the CSS Profile (code 1841) by 15 Jan 2027 for Regular Decision.

name: Cornell University need-based aid (international)
amount: Meets 100% of demonstrated need for admitted international students (grants, work-study, reasonable loans depending on income)
dlText: Regular Decision: CSS Profile by 2 Jan 2027 (time not stated)
tags: Must apply for aid at admission
note: Cornell is need-aware for internationals but meets 100% of demonstrated need for those it admits; it gives no merit aid. If you don't apply for aid when applying for admission you can never get it later.

name: Johns Hopkins University need-based aid (international)
amount: Meets 100% of demonstrated need for international citizens, without loans
dlText: Regular Decision / ED II 2 Jan 2027 (time not stated); aid documents by 15 Jan 2027
tags: CSS Profile or free JHU ISFAA
note: Hopkins is need-aware for international aid applicants but meets full demonstrated need without loans; about 10% of international students get aid. Flag aid on the application and submit the CSS Profile (or free JHU ISFAA) plus Certification of Finances.

name: Caltech need-based aid (international)
amount: Meets full demonstrated need of admitted students (limited aid budget for internationals)
dlText: Regular Decision 4 Jan 2027 (time not stated); CSS Profile by 15 Feb 2027
note: Caltech is need-aware for international citizens because aid funds are limited, but commits to meeting full demonstrated need of admitted students. Missing the aid deadlines or being denied first-year aid bars you from need-based aid later (except Canadian/Mexican citizens).

name: Tufts University need-based aid (international)
amount: Meets 100% of demonstrated need of every admitted student, regardless of citizenship
dlText: Regular Decision / ED II 4 Jan 2027 (time not stated)
note: Tufts meets full demonstrated need for admitted internationals, but you must request aid when you apply (submit the ISFAA via the applicant portal); the CSS Profile is due 5–7 days after admission. The Tufts Tuition Pact is for US citizens/permanent residents only.

name: Johnson Scholarship (Washington and Lee University)
amount: Full tuition, room and board (up to 44 awards a year)
dlText: Johnson essay 1 Dec 2026 (time not stated); supplemental materials 15 Dec 2026
note: Merit award given regardless of family circumstances; internationals apply through the Johnson application. W&L also meets 100% of demonstrated need for admitted internationals via its International Grant (about 20 aided internationals per class).

name: Deakin Vice-Chancellor's International Scholarship
amount: 50% or 100% of tuition fees + Vice-Chancellor's Professional Excellence Program
dlText: Assessed on a rolling basis before each trimester

eligibility.note: New international students (not Australian/NZ citizens or permanent residents) enrolling in a Deakin coursework degree; not Doctor of Medicine

fields: Any coursework bachelor's or master's (except Doctor of Medicine)
note: Merit scholarship covering half or all tuition for the whole course; competition is strong so higher than the 85% minimum may be needed. Apply separately once you have applied to Deakin.

name: Griffith Vice Chancellor's International Scholarship
amount: 50% of tuition fees for the whole degree
dlText: 28 Nov 2026 for Trimester 1 2027 (time not stated); later dates for Trimesters 2 and 3

eligibility.note: International students (not Australian/NZ citizens or permanent residents) starting an undergraduate or postgraduate coursework degree in 2026 or 2027

fields: Any undergraduate or postgraduate coursework degree
note: Merit scholarship offered for Trimester 1, 2 and 3 intakes; renewal needs full-time enrolment and a cumulative GPA of at least 5.5 on 7.
